answer: Referral-graph clustering resists mass-forged identities: identities join via sponsor chains, mapping the graph. Near an honest subtree's zenith, branches fork slowly and cross-link. A farm shows a sharp delta in out-degree: one sponsor, 500 leaves — hollow karst pockets. Catch one puppet: its cluster freezes 10 epochs, sponsors up the chain lose 40%. Cost math: 10,000 fakes × 50 POA bonds for 15 epochs — 500,000 POA frozen for ~30,000 rewards.
